verdict.rationale: ReelMimic ships its own CLI commands that run without the UI: `npm run post-video` takes a project id and flags, supports a scheduled post time and a dry-run mode, and `npm run doctor` re-runs the setup check. The core workflow (submitting a reference, approving the plan, giving feedback) is documented only through the home page and chat UI, so only the publishing and diagnostic steps are shown to be scriptable. missing for 10: headless or CLI triggering of video generation and plan approval, CI integration documentation or examples, a non-interactive mode for the full pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at 2026-10-05T18:00 --tz Europe/Madrid --send
npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok,instagram,youtube # dry run: shows what it would post
You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.
